statements: Okta described pseudonymous actor EM as using the name and photograph of a real person whose public information enabled identity co-option.

EM's claimed residence and employment history differed materially from the real person's history, demonstrating that stolen identity elements can be combined with fabricated biography rather than copied wholesale.

sources.locator: Meet JJ; The DPRK EM; Finding an artificial persona

sources.quote: We will refer to our second actor as "EM".

notes: Publisher pseudonym only; not a legal name, account handle, or verified civil identity.

sources.quote: EM’s employment fraud activity stretches back over a year, with hundreds of interviews again across all verticals, but very much favoring AI-related roles and organizations.

notes: Vendor-observed applicant activity; no affected organization is identified in the retained claim.

sources.quote: Okta Threat Intelligence also observed EM interviewing with sensitive critical national infrastructure (CNI) organizations such as commercial aviation, communications providers, internet service providers, a voting technology company and intelligence and defense contractors.

notes: Only sector categories are retained; affected organization identities are excluded.

value.broader_hire_assessment: likely hired by several organizations into software-development roles
value.posture: publisher assessment distinct from the separately high-confidence employer-post hire

sources.quote: EM has a statistically high occurrence of succeeding in first interviews and being offered multiple rounds of interviews with individual organizations, and is likely to have been hired by several organisations into software development roles.

notes: Okta's broader likelihood assessment, not a count of confirmed hires. No organization, role, application, recruiter, or employment selector was retained.

value.boundary: claimed residence and employment history differed from the real person's history

sources.quote: EM’s professed residential and employment history differs significantly from that of the real person whose identity was assumed.

notes: The real person's name, identity material, biography, and profile selectors are deliberately omitted and are not attributed to the actor.

value.verification_status: claim and presentation only; not accepted as genuine citizenship or identity

sources.locator: The real EM and an identity problem, opening sentence
sources.quote: EM claims to be a US citizen when asked about employment eligibility, and presents very realistic identity documents.

notes: This records a publisher-observed claim and presentation, not verified citizenship or a valid identity document.
The distinct victim name, document type, number, dates, jurisdiction, images, photograph, signature, and comparison material were excluded.

value.conflict: one caller-ID location contradicted the professed biography

sources.quote: Okta Threat Intelligence observed EM offering two different contact phone numbers. Both are VoIP phones - ubiquitous with DPRK actors - and one has a Caller ID location that contradicts their professed biography.

notes: Pattern-level vendor observation only. Phone numbers, caller-ID place labels, providers, routing metadata, and the professed residence were excluded.

sources.quote: The LinkedIn profile listed in their resume has since been taken down by the team at LinkedIn.

notes: Publisher-reported historical status. The path, profile name, victim identity, employer, connections, linked accounts, and removal reason or date were not retained or inferred.

sources.quote: In this case we can say with high confidence that EM has been hired: thanks to a LinkedIn post by their new employer, welcoming their newest hire.

notes: Vendor assessment only. The employer, post, image, role, date, location, and employment selectors are deliberately omitted.

value.attribution_method: combination of technical indicators, behavioral patterns, and first-hand employer reporting
value.count_resolution: use the original September 2025 study's more-than-5,000 figure; the later 500 wording is inconsistent

sources.locator: Inside the investigation: 130+ identities and thousands of targeted companies
sources.quote: We linked these actors to over 6,500 initial job interviews across more than 5,000 distinct companies up until mid-2025.
Okta assesses any given identity as DPRK-aligned based on a combination of technical indicators, behavioural patterns and first-hand employer reporting.
That research collated data from over 130 actors, conducting over 6500 interviews with 500 companies.

notes: Cohort context only; the aggregate does not mean EM personally conducted all interviews or targeted all companies.

The original referenced study is the more authoritative count source and says more than 5,000 distinct companies. The later 500-company wording is retained only as a documented source inconsistency, not normalized as fact.

identity_boundary: EM is an Okta-assigned pseudonym for a tracked applicant actor. Okta reports co-option of a real person's distinct name and identity material alongside materially different claimed biographies. Keep the real person, EM, potentially separate actors and all redacted names, images, documents, employers, locations, accounts, URLs and contact values unresolved.
